# Verify the inferred concentric-square rule against both demo outputs.
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    r0 = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row))
    c0 = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))

             for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
